newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar marginally down in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar marginally down in dull trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices suffered small losses in dull trade on Friday, dealers said.
They said consumer demand was low and sentiment subdued.
"Wholesale demand for the Christmas festival is over and there will be demand only at retail counters," one broker said.
In ready delivery, sugar S-30 slid by 5 rupees to 1,280/1,310 rupees per quintal and M-30 fell by the same amount to 1,305/1,360 rupees per quintal.
Arrivals were low with limited offerings by millers, traders said. Sugar mill delivery was steady at 1,230/1,240 rupees per quintal.
